# Amaca

> Amaca is a dark-first, token-only design system, packaged as rules your AI tools follow. Reference every value by name (`var(--token)`); never hardcode a hex, px, or easing. Dark-first, single typeface (Satoshi), one brand accent (magenta) spent sparingly — the 85/10/5 law. On conflict, the spec (DESIGN.md) wins.

## Start here
- [Design system spec (DESIGN.md)](https://amaca.design/DESIGN.md): the full Amaca spec — tokens + prose (colors, type, spacing, components, motion, accessibility, do/don'ts), in the Google Labs design.md standard.
- [amaca.design](https://amaca.design/): the live system — component gallery, token tables, and the downloads for every AI tool.

## Tokens
- [tokens.css](https://amaca.design/styles/tokens.css): every token as a CSS custom property (`var(--token)`), plus the reset and base.
- [theme.css](https://amaca.design/styles/theme.css): the Tailwind v4 `@theme` projection (`bg-primary-500`, `p-4`, `rounded-lg`) — one-way alias of tokens.css.
- [tokens.dtcg.json](https://amaca.design/downloads/tokens.dtcg.json): the W3C DTCG token file for Style Dictionary / Tokens Studio pipelines.

## Install
- [npm package (amaca-design)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/amaca-design): `npm install amaca-design` — tokens.css, components.css, theme.css, tokens.dtcg.json and DESIGN.md, versioned; also on jsDelivr (`cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/amaca-design@5/`).
- [shadcn registry (registry.json)](https://www.amaca.design/r/registry.json): one item per component — `npx shadcn add https://www.amaca.design/r/<name>.json` writes its CSS and an example, with the tokens; `meta.amaca` carries its usage, parts, rules and variants.

## Use with AI tools
- [AGENTS.md](https://amaca.design/downloads/AGENTS.md): the agent rules (token discipline, the laws, the a11y floor, the verify checklist) on the AGENTS.md standard.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://amaca.design/downloads/CLAUDE.md): the same rules as Claude Code repo memory.
- [AI-INSTRUCTIONS.md](https://amaca.design/downloads/AI-INSTRUCTIONS.md): self-contained paste-in for ChatGPT, Gemini and app builders — token values inlined, no filesystem needed.
- [amaca-frontend agent skill (amaca-frontend.skill)](https://amaca.design/downloads/amaca-frontend.skill): the multi-target build skill (HTML/CSS, React + Tailwind v4, Figma Variables) on the Agent Skills open standard. Upload to Claude, or unpack it under `.agents/skills/` where Cursor 2.4+ and Codex read it — it also ships unpacked inside the IDE bundle.
- [Agent Plugin (amaca-plugin.zip)](https://amaca.design/downloads/zips/amaca-plugin.zip): the installable package — one directory, two manifests, one skill. `plugin.json` on the Agent Plugins 1.0 standard (Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, VS Code, Kiro) + `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` for Claude Code, both pointing at the same `skills/amaca-frontend/`. On Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add angelomacaione/amaca-design` then `/plugin install amaca-design@amaca` — installs from this zip over HTTPS with a SHA-256 pin, no npm, no clone.
- [IDE bundle (amaca-ide.zip)](https://amaca.design/downloads/zips/amaca-ide.zip): the drop-in repo layout — `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` (core always on, html and react glob-scoped), `.github/copilot-instructions.md` + per-target `instructions/`, `AGENTS.md`, and `.agents/skills/amaca-frontend/`.
- [Figma agent skill — /amaca-figma (amaca-figma.md)](https://amaca.design/downloads/amaca-figma.md): in-canvas custom skill for the Figma agent — generate + audit in a verify loop; it fetches this site's llms-full.txt before acting.
